name: Adobe Inc.
quirks: 52/53-week fiscal year: FY ends the Friday nearest Nov 30, so some years close in early December (FY2021 2021-12-03, FY2022 2022-12-02).

ARR was redefined in FY2026: Digital Media ARR (19.20bn at FY2025) was replaced by the broader Total Adobe ARR (25.20bn at FY2025). Charted as one series it fabricates a 36% jump; use the two separate columns.
